dataset.name: Turkish Web Treebank
dataset.description: A human-annotated morphosyntactic treebank for Turkish.

source_domains.web: Turkish forum, blog, how-to, review and guide webpages

citation.title: A Gold Standard Dependency Treebank for Turkish
citation.venue: Proceedings of the 12th Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2020)

source_split.origin: upstream Turkish Web Treebank Python API

quarantined_sentence_ids.tr-forum:00001297:S029: normalized exact surface duplicate of train sentence tr-forum:00001297:S012
quarantined_sentence_ids.tr-forum:00000353:S041: lemma-set Jaccard 0.83333333 with train sentence tr-forum:00002420:S010; exceeds fixed 0.80 near-duplicate threshold

benchmark_config.near_duplicate_metric: Jaccard similarity over casefolded non-PUNCT lemma-or-form sets
benchmark_config.entity_identity: casefolded lemma, or casefolded FORM when LEMMA is underscore; ROOT is a reserved head identity
benchmark_config.negative_generation: For every human-annotated positive basic dependency arc, deterministically replace its head with a different legal sentence head. If no alternative head exists, replace the relation with a different fixed label.
benchmark_config.baseline: selective POS/relation/direction schema frequency verifier with fixed Laplace smoothing and decision thresholds

modification_notice: The vendored CoNLL-U source files are byte-identical to the pinned upstream files. HGA adds deterministic splits, quarantine rules, derived invalid candidates, challenge dimensions and evaluation code; it does not modify upstream annotations.

task_scope.name: basic morphosyntactic dependency-arc candidate verification
task_scope.ground_truth: human-annotated TWT basic dependency heads and relation labels; negatives follow from the single-head basic-tree contract
task_scope.warning: Dependency relations are morphosyntactic arcs, not semantic knowledge triples. Token entities are an operational split key, not named-entity annotations.
